messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Realtime streaming endpoint 'chat/stream' p99 latency > 3.5s (SLO 2.0s) in prod-us-west. Current p95: 1.4s, p99: 3.8s. Error rate normal. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/realtime-latency?orgId=1
oncall-eng: ack — I'm on it, paging SRE.
sre-ally: i'm free, joining. quick checks: k8s pod count, node GPU util, model queue length, kv-cache hit rate.
runtime-lead: saw a small canary rollout 2m ago for kbatch optimization. can we check canary vs prod metrics?
prod-deploy: canary pods show higher tail latency on long-seq tests, rolling back now.
oncall-eng: run `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=streaming -o wide` and `kubectl get hpa -n prod` pls
sre-ally: results: pod count stable 24, 2 pods in CrashLoopBackOff, node gpu util at 96% on nvidia-gpu-3, queue depth for model-infer up to 420, kv-cache miss 18%.
runtime-lead: high GPU util + queue depth indicates kernel stall under long-seq. immediate mitigation: disable continuous batching (set BATCH_MAX=16) or route heavy seqs to fallback-quantized model.
oncall-eng: reducing batch max to 16 on staging, pushing to prod for streaming-ns. doing canary change.
prod-deploy: `kubectl set env deploy/streaming -n prod BATCH_MAX=16 --record`
support-jen: contacting top 10 customers on live feed to check impact, preparing banner.
cs-lucas: pinging enterprise customer 'BrightApps' — they reported intermittent slowness 30m ago.
megan: adding temp traffic split to fallback model: `trafficctl shift streaming --target fallback-qa --percent 20`
incidents-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01, severity: P1, page sent to oncall@redwood
oncall-eng: mitigation in flight. monitoring p95/p99.
sre-ally: after batch change and fallback shift, p95 -> 1.2s, p99 -> 2.1s. KV miss down to 9%.
runtime-lead: rollback of 2m ago canary confirmed; deploys reverting.
prod-deploy: rollback complete.
oncall-eng: good progress. support-jen, cs-lucas, please gather customer impact matrix and start postmortem triggers.
support-jen: will do. collecting timestamps and affected customer ids.
megan: keeping 20% fallback for extra headroom for 30min, then re-evaluate.
sre-ally: creating runbook entry for 'continuous-batching p99 regression' — adding checklist: check canary metrics, GPU util, kv-cache miss, queue depth, rollback steps, fallback routing.
oncall-eng: handing off to SRE team for deep dive. I'll remain available for paging. :thumbsup:
cs-lucas: noted. updating ticket with timeline.
incidents-bot: closing alert (acknowledged) — watch for regressions. :white_check_mark:
